meta_title: RENEW Furniture Atelier | Furniture Restoration & Upholstery
meta_desc: Thoughtful furniture restoration, repairs, reupholstery and refinishing.
headline: New life for furniture. More life in its story.
hero_text: We preserve the character of much-loved pieces and renew their beauty and everyday comfort through careful craftsmanship.
introtext: An old chair, an inherited dresser or a favourite armchair can be much more than a useful object. In our workshop, careful repairs, refinishing and upholstery bring back the beauty, comfort and value of furniture.
services: The right care for every piece
services_lead: From small repairs to complete transformations, we tailor the work to the condition, style and your vision for each piece.
sd1: Renewing tables, chairs, dressers and cabinets while respecting their original character.
sd2: New fabrics, fresh padding and carefully finished details for armchairs, dining chairs and sofas.
sd3: Skilled repairs to scratches, cracks, damaged veneer and loose joints.
sd4: Sanding, staining, oiling, varnishing or painting for the finish and durability you want.
sd5: Gentle cleaning and restoration of older pieces, with care for original details and patina.
sd6: Personalised changes to colour, materials and function so a treasured piece fits a new setting.
whytext: Restoration preserves personal memories, reduces unnecessary waste and can create a unique piece you simply would not find ready-made in a shop.
why2: Careful preparation and attention to detail
why3: Fabrics and finishes selected for you
projects_lead: Every piece is different. The grain, shape, age and marks of use all help determine the right restoration approach.
process: Four steps to a renewed piece
process_lead: Every project begins by understanding the furniture and its condition. We work through clear, agreed stages.
step1d: Send a few photos and tell us what you would like to preserve or change.
step2d: We assess the piece, discuss materials, the work involved and the expected cost.
step3d: We carry out the necessary repairs, refinishing or upholstery with attention to every detail.
step4d: We check the finished piece and share tips to help you care for it over time.
quote: “Not every old piece is outdated. Some are simply waiting to be rediscovered.”
contact: Have a piece that deserves a new life?
contacttext: Send us a photo of the furniture and let’s explore the possibilities together.
